fact: Morocco's education ministry launched the 2025-2026 annual school census, running from 20 October to 20 November 2025, with updates to the Massar system as the main reference from which most statistical data come, per a ministry letter reported by Express TV.
The Ministry of National Education's memorandum launching the annual school census tells regional officials to complete the census data, including primary enrolment, in the Massar system.

The ministry's memorandum orders new first-year primary pupils in public, private and non-structured schools to be enrolled in Massar, with duplicate enrolment avoided, and nationality and disability type recorded for each pupil.
